<!-- pr-reviewer: a165c5cfeeb4b757b403de8fb883f3c07acd4443 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge after #3990, #3992 and #3993. No blocking findings.

I checked the full diff against current main and the final overlay commit, a165c5cfe. The overlay tokens keep the old RGBA values. Each new theme key maps to its own token. The omitted keys keep their base values. The example theme, guide and decision record match the code.

This change affects UI colours only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks or stock simulation. No dependency, build script, workflow or process file changes are present.

Local results, trial-merged with upstream/main `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`:

- Trial merge: clean. The first parent is the full PR head shown above.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. This includes the local test build.

| UI suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| lib | 1688 | 0 | 8 |
| boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| boundary_picks | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| contour_dxf_sketch | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| sinker_setup | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| tap_hand | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| theme_example | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| theme_files | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

The theme suites include both new overlay tests, the example-default check and the colour-literal guard.

Extra suites run:

`cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'` ran every light test. Each selected step built its test target in release mode.

| Light step | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| motion light: lib | 7 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_island | 1 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_neck | 1 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel | 1 | 0 |
| app light: pocket_pass_start | 1 | 0 |

`cargo clippy -j 16 --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: passed.

No fixture, importer, toolpath or post changes require further named suites. No full heavy lane was required. No mutation test was required for this UI-only change. No NC or CL goldens moved.

The body has before and after screenshots for the generate panel, drop hint and empty view in both themes. I downloaded all six pairs and checked their pixels. Four pairs are identical. The generate panel differs by 14 dark-theme pixels and 62 light-theme pixels, each within the activity-bar strip. These results match the body. The images are on the fork's images-only branch.

Requested before merge: none.

GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. The review meets the `merge-ready` conditions. I left the labels, title and draft state unchanged, as instructed. I kept the local review worktree and branch for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand. Please mark this draft ready with `gh pr ready 4072 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.

`merge-ready` set: the collaborator review of head `a165c5cfe` is clean and asked to merge after #3990, #3992 and #3993, which are all merged now. The PR is ready (not a draft), its head is unchanged, and GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
